claims.statement: Decoder contract 22 retains contract 21's complete value-derived usage-v2 revision semantics while migrating root-scoped usage to the corrected canonical root actor key. The common reducer recomputes each complete normalized response identity, suppresses an exact current-value repeat across decode batches and durable commits, builds query-bootstrap state as a non-consumption baseline, delivers post-barrier metadata corrections, and explicitly retracts old response entities on live generation replacement. A non-consecutive A-to-B-to-A reversion reuses A's semantic ledger row but remains a new ordered transition. A stable-clone adapter-independent census found 262 such reversions, and a contract-22 artifact-bound full ingest passed exact response/actor/session/bucket parity, complete Ready coverage, and final foreign-key integrity without retaining native values.
